proposition_2_conditional_threshold.verbatim_source_clause:
Proposición 2 (Umbral condicional). Bajo los Supuestos 1–4, existe un único κ∗ ∈ (0, 1) con
∂D q ∗ (D0 , κ∗ ) = 0. La derivada es positiva para κ < κ∗ y negativa para κ > κ∗ .
proposition_2_conditional_threshold.semantic_claim: Under Assumptions 1–4 there is a unique kappa* in (0,1) at which the D-derivative of optimal risk at D0 is zero; that derivative is positive below kappa* and negative above it.

proposition_3_transmission_composition.verbatim_source_clause:
Proposición 3 (Transmisión y composición). Bajo los Supuestos 1–3 y 5, el ratio esperado de
cartera es M (D) = (1 − w)m0 + wq ∗ (D). En cualquier régimen diferenciable, escribiendo βD =

proposition_3_transmission_composition.semantic_claim: Under Assumptions 1–3 and 5, the expected portfolio ratio is M(D) = (1-w(D)) m0 + w(D) q*(D).
In every differentiable regime, writing beta_D for the D-derivative of q*, the derivative of the portfolio ratio is M' = w beta_D + w' (q* - m0).

proposition_3_transmission_composition.verbatim_source_clause:
Si B es constante, el signo es el de βD . Si βD ̸= 0 y |w′ (q ∗ − m0 )| < w|βD |, el signo también se

proposition_3_transmission_composition.semantic_claim: If the new-cohort balance B is constant, M' has the sign of beta_D; if beta_D is nonzero and the absolute composition term is strictly smaller than w |beta_D|, that sign is also preserved.

proposition_3_transmission_composition.verbatim_source_clause:
Con B(D) = B1 e−εD , B1 > 0, ε ≥ 0,
M ′ = w{βD − ε(1 − w)(q ∗ − m0 )}.
proposition_3_transmission_composition.semantic_claim: For B(D) = B1 exp(-epsilon D), with B1 > 0 and epsilon >= 0, M' = w { beta_D - epsilon (1-w) (q* - m0) }.

proposition_3_transmission_composition.verbatim_source_clause: En particular, βD > 0 y q ∗ > m0 generan M ′ < 0 si y solo si ε(1 − w)(q ∗ − m0 ) > βD .
proposition_3_transmission_composition.semantic_claim: In particular, when beta_D > 0 and q* > m0, M' < 0 if and only if epsilon (1-w) (q* - m0) > beta_D.
